title: The checks-shoot job has room for the waiting-page tests, so batch 70 is not cancelled at its cap
why: Coordinator 16:15 CST Nov 9: on batch 70 (#2470, head f2d25d149) the checks-shoot job was cancelled at its 10 min cap (.github/workflows/checks.yml) while still passing, after the batch added waiting-page tests (#2347, #2383, #2423, #2429, #2466). The same job took 8 min on 624dcc188 and 7 min on 8bc28980b.
note: Fix: split the waiting-page suite into its own job, or raise the cap from measured runs, per decision ci-job-caps. Done check: the shoot jobs pass on a tree with batch 70's page tests, and each cap cites its measured runs. Related: ci-guard-headroom (lane session_013NEJKypwFEtaJwfYrMpZ5T). Lane session_013NEJL2Xf2CDoR4VGP4EE6P started 16:16 CST Nov 9 (coordinator). Scope widened (coordinator 16:27 CST Nov 9): three caps, checks-shoot, checks-merge-install's checkout-detection step, and shell-macos's; #2458 was a draft, so its own run skipped every job by design. Coordinator 19:48 CST Nov 9: the batch-70 cut hid 126 failing waiting-page cases (font-dependent pins), so the cap was not the only cause; see steps capped-job-hides-red and page-pins-font-dependent. Runner 8 dropped #2347, #2383, #2423, #2429 and #2466 from batch 70; it rebuilds as batch-70c. PR #2478 (branch shoot-job-cap-b: the waiting-page suite in its own CI job; install suite steps re-capped) released into batch-70c (coordinator 20:36 CST Nov 9). #2478 was closed unmerged and is not in batch 70 (read 00:51 CST Nov 10); the step has no live PR. Back to todo until the coordinator names its next PR. Doing 00:54 CST Nov 10: next PR is #2497 (branch shoot-job-cap-c, replaces #2478), per the coordinator. Follow-ups after #2497 merges (coordinator 01:12 CST Nov 10): fix the wrong n6 in the comment on checks.yml's shell-macos job; re-measure the checks-waiting-page cap (provisional 60, n=1 red run) on a green run, and again at 5 green runs. Kept doing on: #2497 open draft (shoot-job-cap-c); #2478 closed unmerged (triage reader agent, Explore Sonnet audit, read of origin/main 0e6509a96,  CST Nov 10).
